summary: Frontend-only retest of the two navigation-stack issues left open in iteration 79. Done with Playwright on the web preview at 375x667, logged in as voicetest2026@example.com. FIX A passes: after Start journey, only the hub and the active screen are in the stack, and header Back (fj-back) from the active screen goes to the Family Journey hub. FIX B passes: Change the plan → Choose contacts → See the preview → Back to journey (fj-preview-back-active) lands on /family-journey/active, the new/contacts/preview screens are removed, and Back goes to the hub, not into setup. See all previews → Back to journey also returns to the journey. The Me row reads 'Family Journey / Preview' in English and 'फैमिली जर्नी / प्रीव्यू' in Hindi. Regression checks pass: the master toggle hides and shows the Home card and Me row without a reload, and the Data & Privacy toggle works. Previews show the exact label 'Preview — nothing has been sent.' Stop journey returns to the hub, clears the stack and deletes the stored journey. Home, Me, Settings → Data & Privacy and Trusted Circle all load. No page errors. One LOW-priority edge case remains, and only for direct links: if the user opens /family-journey/new by URL or after a web reload, the hub is not in the stack, and dismissTo('/family-journey') puts the hub on top of new and contacts. Back from active goes to the hub (correct), but Back again opens 'Choose contacts' and then 'Change the plan'. No deprecated Expo packages were seen in the changed files.

ui_bugs.component: preview.tsx start() — opened by direct link
ui_bugs.issue: Steps: open /family-journey/new directly by URL (hub not in the stack), then Choose contacts, See the preview and Start. dismissTo('/family-journey') cannot find the hub, so it pushes the hub on top: the stack becomes [new, contacts, hub, active]. Back → hub is correct, but Back from the hub opens 'Choose contacts' and then 'Change the plan'. The normal in-app flow (Home card → hub → plan) is fine. Reference: app/family-journey/preview.tsx:41-46

action_items: Optional (LOW): make start() work even when the hub is not in the stack (direct link or web reload). One way is router.dismissAll() and then router.replace('/family-journey') and router.push('/family-journey/active'). Another is to check router.canDismiss() or the navigation state first.
critical_code_review_comments: start() and 'Back to journey' use try/catch around dismissTo as the fallback. dismissTo does not throw when the route is missing (it pushes or navigates instead), so the replace fallback in the catch never runs in the edge case above.
The stop confirm sheet has testID fj-stop-confirm, and its action button is the shared fj-confirm-yes. Tests must tap fj-confirm-yes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested checks (4/4 areas). One LOW edge case is outside the requested flow.

seed_data_creation: Only on-device localStorage for the test account: fj_journey_v1_<uid> (TEST_NavRetest, TEST_NavRetest2, TEST_NavRetest3, TEST_DeepLink, TEST_DeepLink2). All were stopped or removed. The switch fj_enabled_v1_<uid> was left ON and the language reset to EN. No server data was created or changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the iteration 79 fast-auth seeding (see /app/tests/family_journey_ui_test.py). Start from /home and use home-family-journey-card so the hub is in the stack. When a journey is running the hub shows fj-resume-active. Stop: fj-stop then fj-confirm-yes. Each browser_automation run gets fresh localStorage, so create a journey in every run.
rca_of_issue: Edge case: in expo-router 6, dismissTo(href) pops back to href if it is in the stack. If it is not, it navigates or pushes instead of throwing. Opened by direct link, the stack starts at /new, so the hub is pushed on top and the setup screens stay underneath.
